description: This file defines a Java interface named BankingService, which declares methods related to banking operations such as managing customers, accounts, and transactions within a banking application. It includes method signatures for CRUD operations and transaction handling, referencing domain classes within the project.

classes.name: BankingService
classes.description: A Java interface defining banking operations such as customer management, account management, and transaction processing.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customer details.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer with the provided customer details, returns an HTTP response.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds customer details by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer details identified by customerNumber.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer identified by customerNumber.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds account information by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a customer, given account information and customer number.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs a transfer operation based on provided transfer details and customer number.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves transaction details for a specific account.
